name: Custom ERP/CRM for medical device manufacturing

mentions.name: Custom ERP/CRM for medical device manufacturing
mentions.description: A custom ERP/CRM system built for a medical device manufacturing company. It handles inventory, work orders (MRP), purchasing, sales orders, and accounting, and now runs the company day to day. Built as a simpler replacement for commercial ERPs after two failed commercial implementations, with a focus on avoiding the unnecessary complexity ERP systems tend to accumulate.
mentions.problem: The company went through two commercial ERPs that were slow and painful to customize.
mentions.audience: Other manufacturing companies struggling with slow, hard-to-customize commercial ERPs
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been building a custom ERP/CRM system for the medical device manufacturing company I work at. We went through two commercial ERPs over the years and both were slow and painful to customize, so I started building a simpler replacement.

It handles inventory, work orders (MRP), purchasing, sales orders, accounting, everything we need.
